youtube.title: What if you were a powder monkey at Trafalgar?
youtube.description:
21 October 1805: you are thirteen, aboard HMS Victory, and your job is to carry gunpowder from the copper-lined magazine below the waterline up to the guns – for five and a half hours. 💥⚓ Ship's boys went to sea as young as twelve.
Could you do this job? A) Yes, I'm fast B) Only in the magazine C) No way – Comment A, B or C 👇
Sources: Royal Museums Greenwich, "Battle of Trafalgar", "HMS Victory" and "Cabin boy"; Historic UK, "Powder Monkeys"; HMS Victory armament (32-pounders, ~2.75 t) per Wikipedia / Goodwin, Nelson's Victory
